card.name: Inside drug and medical names
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a drug name or long medical term, such as the 'en' in finerenone, the 'one' in abiraterone, or the 'pr' in omeprazole. It also fires on a few other stray short fragments.

modes.description: Middle or ending piece of a generic drug name, usually just before the rest of the name or a dosage form.
